verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for an AI code-review SaaS with a CLI and MCP server, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no setting, flag, or policy for opting out of telemetry or usage tracking. The analytics dashboard and Analytics API describe team metrics, a different feature, and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
